fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld, from the ld+json @graph's NewsArticle node) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, front-page /feed/portada.xml) carry title/link-style fields plus a full articleBody parsed from the feed's own CDATA HTML.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld, S1-jsonld+meta-fallback, S2-rss, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node (article mode only).

alternativeHeadline.title: Alternative headline
alternativeHeadline.description: Secondary/shorter headline variant from ld+json (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary from the ld+json `description` field (article mode only).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text. Article mode: from the ld+json `articleBody` field (HTML-entity-unescaped), falling back to the meta[name=ArticleText] tag if ever absent. Latest mode: paragraphs parsed out of the RSS item's own CDATA-wrapped HTML description, which already carries the complete story.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name. Article mode: from the ld+json author Person node. Latest mode: from the RSS item's category tagged vn="Autores".

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name from the ld+json publisher object (article mode only, always "Diario Libre").

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Comma-joined section/subsection path from ld+json, e.g. "actualidad,educacion" (article mode only).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: List of keyword tags, split from the ld+json comma-separated `keywords` string (article mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json (article mode only).

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: ld+json inLanguage code, always "es" (article mode only).

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.description: mainEntityOfPage @id from ld+json, the canonical article URL (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item (latest mode only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item guid -- a UUID, not the numeric id in the article URL (latest mode only).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RSS pubDate string, in the feed's own (non-standard, Spanish month abbreviation) format (latest mode only).

category.title: Category
category.description: Section name, from the RSS item's category tagged vn="Categorias" (latest mode only).

subcategory.title: Subcategory
subcategory.description: Subsection name, from the RSS item's category tagged vn="Subcategorias" (latest mode only).

place.title: Place
place.description: Place tag, from the RSS item's category tagged vn="Lugares" (latest mode only).

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: List of topic tags, from the RSS item's repeated category entries tagged vn="Temas" (latest mode only).

principalTopic.title: Principal topic
principalTopic.description: Lead topic tag, from the RSS item's category tagged vn="PrincipalTema" (latest mode only).

readingTime.title: Reading time
readingTime.description: Estimated reading time in minutes, from the RSS item's <description readingtime="N"> attribute (latest mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL. Article mode: from the ld+json ImageObject. Latest mode: from the RSS item's media:content url.

imageCaption.title: Image caption
imageCaption.description: Lead image caption, from the RSS item's media:title (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
